description: ARM NEON assembly implementation of Galois Hash functions (GHASH) used in cryptography, specifically optimized for AArch64 architecture within BoringSSL's cryptographic module.

methods.name: gcm_init_neon
methods.description: Initializes the NEON-based Galois Hash table with the H value.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_neon
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication using NEON instructions.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_neon
methods.description: Computes GHASH over input data using NEON SIMD instructions.
